**Make is a page CMS, the 3440 spacing is one number, the importance system exists, and three critique rounds ran until nothing above minor remained.** Everything is uncommitted on michael/dev for the owner review.

- [Make](/imagine/paging/make/) - tree | the picked page drawn for real | its settings; drag-and-drop sorting and nesting; every control labelled with a visible consequence (41 of 42 kinds). Build folded in.
- [Importance](/imagine/importance/) - the owner brief end to end: JSONL typed graph beside the pages, pairwise judgments appended over the socket, context view, [judge screen](/imagine/importance/judge/?at=car), propose, reuse overlay, live across windows in 5-9 ms, a bot CLI. Two topics seeded.
- [Spacing](/framework/ai/2026-09-13/paging-spacing-3440/spacing.md) - the --flow ceiling 3em -> 2.5em: paragraph gap 3440/1280 went 1.80x -> 1.50x, 1280 byte-identical. Three decisions left for the owner: the gap token (3.07x), the pad token, the 40em measure at 3440.
- [Core proposal](/framework/core/Page/doc/data-children/) - children as a data source (proposed, ~22 core lines, 63 net out of two callers); Page.redraw() refuted. Nothing in core moved.
- Critique loop: [round 1](/framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-critique/) 10 defects -> [fixes](/framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-fixes/) -> [round 2](/framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-critique-2/) 11 -> [fixes 2](/framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-fixes-2/) -> [round 3](/framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-critique-3/) stop -> [7 minors closed](/framework/ai/2026-09-13/self-evident-minors/).

![](make-after-1920.png)

Left, with reasons: keyboard drag on the tree (not asked; pointer only); Make Description field shows nowhere on the screen (a fix would be new prose); the reason box on the judge screen types a pick key rather than casting (an accidental permanent append is worse). Eight traps applied to the code, css, ui-test and documentation skills. 14 agent runs, about 4.7M tokens across minions; the mastermind itself 92.7M including cache reads over 217 calls.
